heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1P handles Sunlu PETG exceptionally well right out of the box using its stock stainless steel nozzle and open-frame design. Based on Sunlu PETG's 15 mm³/s volumetric flow limit, the machine achieves a safe maximum print speed of 179 mm/s at standard 0.2mm layer heights.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate with liquid glue or glue stick as a necessary release agent
slicerTweaks: Cap Maximum Volumetric Speed at 15 mm³/s under Filament Settings > Basic Information to prevent under-extrusion at high print speeds.
Enable 'Wipe while retracting' set to 2 mm with a 0.8 mm retraction distance to minimize PETG nozzle oozing and fine stringing.
Adjust Part Cooling Fan speeds to Min 20% and Max 50%, with Fan Speed Threshold layer times set to 30s to maximize layer adhesion without causing overhang sagging.
Set First Layer Speed to 35 mm/s and First Layer Acceleration to 500 mm/s² to ensure proper laydown without dragging or tearing.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Sunlu PETG is hygroscopic and exhibits higher melt viscosity than PLA, leading to oozing during travel moves.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry the filament in an active dryer at 65°C for 6 hours; in OrcaSlicer, increase retraction to 0.8mm at 35 mm/s and enable 'Avoid Crossing Walls'.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: First Layer Tearing or PEI Coating Damage
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PETG bonds aggressively to smooth or bare PEI surfaces and can rip the coating, or adheres poorly if squished too aggressively.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Apply a thin layer of PVA glue stick or Bambu liquid glue as a sacrificial release agent, and set Z-hop to 0.4mm during travel moves.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Excessive auxiliary cooling or print speeds exceeding the 15 mm³/s flow capability of the hotend.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Turn off the auxiliary chamber fan completely in the filament cooling tab and verify nozzle temperature is at 240°C to 245°C.

faq.question: Can I print Sunlu PETG on the P1P without an enclosure?
faq.answer: Yes. PETG does not require an enclosed chamber and printing it in the P1P's open frame is optimal to prevent heat creep.

faq.question: Do I need to upgrade to a hardened steel nozzle for Sunlu PETG?
faq.answer: No. Standard Sunlu PETG is non-abrasive, making the stock stainless steel nozzle on the P1P completely suitable.

faq.question: Why does PETG stick too strongly to my build plate?
faq.answer: PETG has high molecular adhesion to PEI. Always apply a thin layer of glue stick or liquid glue as an interface release agent to prevent surface tear-out.

faq.question: What is the maximum printing speed I can use for Sunlu PETG on the P1P?
faq.answer: Given the hotend's 15 mm³/s volumetric limit with standard PETG, the maximum safe linear speed at a 0.2mm layer height and 0.42mm line width is 179 mm/s.
